evidence.quote: In recent months, inflation moved notably higher because of higher energy costs.
I view risks around my inflation outlook as tilted to the upside.
I see risks to the labor market as somewhat skewed to the downside.
I have not prejudged the next meeting and look forward to engaging with my colleagues about the policy necessary to best achieve our dual-mandate goals.
I expect a more modest pace of growth this year as households face high energy costs.

parsed.rationale: The speech balances upside inflation risks from energy and tariffs against downside labor-market risks and slowing growth, and it keeps policy on hold with no prejudgment of the next move. A firm commitment to the 2 percent goal and rising inflation tilt it very slightly hawkish.
